literal_meaning: নাক এবং কান বন্ধ করা (closing or blocking the nose and ears)
figurative_meaning_en: To remain silent without protesting or complaining
similar_in_english: Turn a blind eye and a deaf ear
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে অন্যায় দেখেও নাক-কান বুজে থাকে।
এত অপবাদ শুনে নাক-কান বুজে চুপ করে রইলো।
example_sentences_in_english: He turns a blind eye and deaf ear to injustice.
Despite hearing all the slander, she remained silent with closed nose and ears.
note: This idiom metaphorically describes willful ignorance to avoid confrontation, common in Bengali discourse on social apathy.
